title: What retrieve returns and what bounds it
trigger: when calling the DD retrieve/orient tools, or changing how retrieval selects and sizes memories
behavior_delta: Expect at most 8 memories within a 600-token estimated budget: candidates come from FTS plus, when the resident process runs, nearest embeddings; the top memory arrives in its short form if that takes at most half the budget, and further applicable memories fall back to micro or to a one-sentence headline with the id to fetch. vpt_threshold is a floor on marginal value, not a per-token ratio. Use get only when one memory's full rationale, evidence or relations are needed.
what: Expect at most 8 memories within a 600-token estimated budget: candidates come from FTS plus, when the resident process runs, nearest embeddings; the top memory arrives in its short form if that takes at most half the budget, and further applicable memories fall back to micro or to a one-sentence headline with the id to fetch. vpt_threshold is a floor on marginal value, not a per-token ratio. Use get only when one memory's full rationale, evidence or relations are needed.
why: Measured 2026-09-22: the old value-per-token gate capped every memory near 50 tokens, so reviewed advice longer than a sentence never injected; one ~470-token micro form filled the pack alone. The headline fallback and the value floor fixed both, verified by tests/engine/cognition/retrieval-reach.test.js and the task benchmark.
